entries.german:
1279. 0. T. Rosenberch. — Derselbe schenkt demselben die Kirche zu Rosenberg.

XXVI. Bone rei datur consilium, ut presentis uite conferatur sub- sidium, vbi eterne remuneracionis premium exspectatur. Sciant 32 igitur presentes ac posteri, quod ego Heinricus de Rosenberch pre- ceptis diuinis et salutaribus informatus domui sánete Marie virginis in Hohenfurt, quam pater meus pie memorie dominus Wokko multa beniuolencia cepit construere et fundare, ecclesiam in Rosenberch post mortem et obitum domini Jacobi plebani sacerdotis libcraliter omni iure, quo ipsam tenuit et possedit, tradidi perpetuo possiden- dam, vt fratres ibidem domino iugiter seruientes et pro salute mea atque progenitorum et successorum meorum fideles ad dominum intercessore» non alicuius necessitatis occasio aut desides faciat, aut robur sanete conuersacionis quod absit, infringat, quia plurimis indi gent, qui indigencias plurimorum conantur fideliter releuare. Vt autem bec rata permaneant et nulla queant inposterum calumpnia perturbari, preseötem cartam ipsis tradidi mei sigilli munimine robo- ratam cum testibus subnotatis, qui sunt: Dominus Andreas miles, Leupoldus, dominus Benata miles, Onscho ipsius Crater, Nycolaus, Vlricus de Weischel et eius frater Bseborius, Troyanus suisque fra- tribus et alii quam piures. entries.english: Heinrich von Rosenberg gives the church at Rosenberg to the house of Saint Mary at Hohenfurt, which his father Woko began to build and found. After the death of the priest Jacob, the church with all the rights by which he held and possessed it is to belong to the monastery forever, so that its brethren may pray faithfully to God for the salvation of Heinrich, his ancestors, and his successors.
